`webauthn.json` is copied from the local fido2 2.0.0 test fixtures.
It contains deterministic, public test keys and WebAuthn signatures generated by
that library's `rust/examples/generate_fixtures.rs`. It is used to exercise this
application's COSE inspection and credential persistence across all six algorithms.

`canokey-packed.json` is a user-supplied CanoKey ES256 registration response for
`https://dev.canokeys.org`. It contains public credential data and an attestation
certificate (including the device serial), but no private keys. It reproduces
the packed-format rejection in fido2 2.0.0 and tests registration and signature
tampering with 2.0.1. Its fixed challenge is only for offline regression tests;
the tests do not establish certificate-chain trust.
